component.name: EyeCanSee
component.summary: Viewer, manager and editor for photos, videos, 3D models and CAD drawings
Visualizzatore, gestore ed editor di foto, video, modelli 3D e disegni CAD

description.p: A viewer, manager and editor for photos, videos, 3D models and CAD drawings: browse them on computers, disks, servers and phones, copy and move them from one device to another, find duplicate copies and convert them to other formats.

Un visualizzatore, gestore ed editor di foto, video, modelli 3D e disegni CAD: sfogliali su computer, dischi, server e telefoni, copiali e spostali da un dispositivo all'altro, trova le copie doppie e convertili in altri formati.

ul.li: Folders on the computer, external disks, USB sticks and SD cards, with cached thumbnails
Cartelle del computer, dischi esterni, chiavette USB e schede SD, con le miniature in cache
Viewer with zoom, photo details (camera, exposure, date, location) and a slideshow
Visore con zoom, dettagli della foto (fotocamera, esposizione, data, posizione) e presentazione
Copy, move, rename and delete, also between devices, with a trash on every device
Copia, sposta, rinomina ed elimina, anche tra dispositivi, con un cestino su ogni dispositivo
Videos with thumbnails, playback with sound, their details, and conversion with FFmpeg (MP4, MKV, WebM, H.264, HEVC, AV1, VP9…), on the graphics card when it can
Video con miniature, riproduzione con l'audio, dettagli e conversione con FFmpeg (MP4, MKV, WebM, H.264, HEVC, AV1, VP9…), sulla scheda video quando può
3D models and CAD drawings in the grid and in the viewer, exported to other formats
Modelli 3D e disegni CAD nella griglia e nel visore, esportati in altri formati
Android phones and cameras opened directly over USB, much faster than through the file manager
Telefoni Android e fotocamere aperti direttamente via USB, molto più veloce che dal file manager
SFTP, FTP and FTPS servers browsed like any folder, saved with password or SSH key
Server SFTP, FTP e FTPS sfogliati come qualunque cartella, salvati con password o chiave SSH
Image editor: arrows, shapes, text, highlighter, numbered steps, stamps, magnifier, cover boxes, filters, crop and rotate, saved as a copy with the metadata, also on phones and servers

Editor delle immagini: frecce, forme, testo, evidenziatore, numeri di passaggio, timbri, lente, coperture, filtri, ritaglio e rotazione, salvati in una copia con i metadati, anche su telefoni e server
Duplicate finder, rotation and cropping, saving and converting many images at once
Ricerca dei duplicati, rotazione e ritaglio, salvataggio e conversione di molte immagini insieme
JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC, AVIF, JPEG XL, TIFF, SVG, PSD, Camera RAW and many rare formats
JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC, AVIF, JPEG XL, TIFF, SVG, PSD, Camera RAW e molti formati rari

screenshot.caption: Saving in another format, the original and the result side by side

ul.li: Image editor: the window title and the viewer stay on the image being edited, and after closing the editor show the file saved last
Image editor: a click or a shape outside the image no longer leaves an object there, and overlapping filters and highlighters look as in the saved file
Save in another format keeps Ultra HDR photos in JPEG, and suits a new image (PNG, no "0 KB")
Replace no longer loses the original in three rare cases: a copy inside the same phone, folders mounted by the file manager, an original left by a save cut short
Same as the system follows the desktop's light or dark theme on Linux, and a change at once on Windows
Fedora: with the system's mpv or FFmpeg without H.264 and HEVC decoders, phone videos use the downloaded engine instead of staying black
More RAW files: Sony SRF and SR2 open, Canon CRW portraits are upright; EXIF is shown also when a part of it is not valid
Windows: quoted paths ending in a backslash, quotes in the address bar and a drive letter alone open the right folder
Image editor: in Options, what happens after saving: stay in the editor, go back to where you were, or go back to the thumbnails
Image editor: Overwrite the original can be the main save button, also for Ctrl+S
Image editor: Save as no longer closes the editor before the file is written, so closing it without saving keeps the drawing; the saved file is then selected
Phones on Windows: video thumbnails and playback no longer copy the whole video first, and a large copy stays fast while you browse the phone
Phones on Windows: no more "the phone is not answering" while a large file is being written to it
The Options window is wide enough for all its tabs
An illustrated guide in the program: F1 opens the page of what is on screen, with search across every page
Bookmarks: folders, disks, phones and servers saved by name and opened with one click, from the star next to the address bar, the Bookmarks menu or Ctrl+Shift+D
Open location: Save and open keeps the server and its password
SFTP: faster downloads from a distant server
SFTP and FTP: videos from a distant server play without stutter, also in 4K, when the connection is fast enough
Messages with a title, errors in plain words in a yellow band
Find duplicates: a file reached through a link to a folder is no longer taken for its own copy
Grid: pointing at a file shows its details, with the full name, the file size, the date and the size in pixels
A save or a paste that fails, for example on a full disk, no longer leaves a half-written file
Many fixes: Ctrl+R in the grid, the editor's Save on closing, the slideshow of a folder, the Image box of RAW files, a file whose name is not valid UTF-8 no longer reported as removed
Convert and resize: with an NVIDIA, Intel Quick Sync or VA-API encoder the graphics card also reads, turns and resizes the video
Options: the automatic choice of the video engine and FFmpeg, the best for this computer
The viewer leaves the enlarging of a video to the graphics card and uses less processor
Convert and resize: Cancel also stops a file being downloaded from a server or uploaded to it
SFTP: a server that stops answering is left, usually after about 20 seconds of silence, and the work goes on over a new connection
Open location: a user name or password with % reaches the server as written
Thumbnails waiting for the video or CAD engine show a download badge
The built-in SQLite updated to 3.54 for a security advisory
EyeCanSee as a Flatpak for every Linux distribution, from its own signed repository at flatpak.montinaro.info
A phone or camera held or kept busy by another program: the message says what to do; in the Flatpak on KDE, Release the phone
The viewer's error message is larger and easier to read
Server manager: the warning without a master password says to set one to encrypt the list of servers
The short description mentions the image editor
Ultra HDR photos stay Ultra HDR when Convert and resize writes them as JPEG, also resized; in the other formats the window says that they lose their HDR
Motion photos that are also Ultra HDR (Pixel, Xiaomi) keep their HDR in the image editor, and Save and Convert turn them with their video
Save as proposes the quality and colour detail of a JPEG original; converted phone photos no longer describe a gain map they do not have
Paste and Ctrl+V paste the files copied in EyeCanSee only while the clipboard still holds them, not after a copy in another program
Phones, servers and other disks: the thumbnails of the pictures come first, and a turning circle shows the thumbnails being made
Server manager: a clearer warning when no master password is set

Image editor (Ctrl+E): lines, arrows, rectangles, ellipses, freehand, highlighter, spotlight, text, speech bubbles, step numbers, stamps, magnifier, cover boxes for private data, filters, selection with copy and paste, crop and rotate, eyedropper, undo and redo

The editor saves a copy next to the original, updates it or overwrites the original (which goes to a trash), keeping the metadata, on the computer, phones and servers; the result can be copied to the clipboard
Toolbar with line icons, Save and Save as; full screen (F11) shows the image or video alone; the window's close button in the viewer goes back to the grid (an option)
Ctrl+Left and Ctrl+Right jump 5 seconds in a video; Enter and Esc close the result windows; a server's key or certificate fingerprint is shown apart, to compare

Windows: a phone photo opened from File Explorer arrives as a temporary copy made by Windows; EyeCanSee says so and never saves over it, offering Save as…, so a change can no longer stay in the copy while the photo on the phone is left as it was

Phone photos opened from the file manager use EyeCanSee's direct connection; saving over a file in folders of the file manager's connection (gvfs) is refused, with Save as…, so a photo can no longer be left only under a hidden name
The metadata panel shows the EXIF of CR3, RAF, ORF, RW2 and MRW photos
Extended XMP of JPEG photos is kept when they are encoded again, and the IPTC digest of a written TIFF matches its IPTC
Photos in the Android trash are shown by their own name in the status bar, the metadata panel and the Delete and Restore windows
Saved and converted images keep their XMP, IPTC and colour profile, TIFF its EXIF, and no longer carry a preview of the original
RAW photos of every maker keep their EXIF and XMP when converted, with an sRGB profile; files read through ImageMagick keep their metadata
Saving on a phone or a server keeps the changed image on the computer when sending fails, with Try again
Copying inside a phone with "Keep both" no longer damages the file already there
3D models in the grid and in a 3D viewer: STL, 3MF, OBJ, PLY, glTF, FBX, Collada, 3DS, OFF, AMF, VRML, X3D, IFC buildings, and STEP, IGES and BREP with a CAD engine downloaded on first use
CAD drawings: DWG, DXF and HP-GL, sharp at any zoom, exported as images, SVG or between DWG and DXF
The video engine is used as soon as it is downloaded, without restarting
Menus show only the items that work for the chosen files
Moving a folder no longer loses the files in its own trash
Deleting a folder warns when it contains files or folders that EyeCanSee does not show
